job.title: Product Operations Manager
job.description:
About the Role
Our client is seeking a Product Operations Manager to lead the data-driven operation, commercialisation and optimisation of live game products across mobile and web platforms. The role will translate player behaviour, product performance, market intelligence and revenue data into operational strategies, monetisation plans and prioritised product improvements, while leading cross-functional delivery and developing local operations capability. 

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end operation of live game products, including event calendars, seasonal content, promotional activities, in-game sales plans and version optimisation.
  • Analyse player onboarding, progression, retention, payer conversion, ARPPU, LTV and ROI to diagnose product issues and prioritise operational and product improvements.
  • Develop and optimise monetisation strategies, including player-segment-based offers, progression incentives, season passes, promotional packages and other commercial initiatives, balancing short-term conversion with long-term retention and revenue.
  • Evaluate product performance before and after releases, and translate quantitative data, player feedback and community sentiment into clear, prioritised change requests.
  • Evaluate prospective game titles and genres using structured product assessment, player insights, market research and competitor analysis, and recommend product introduction, optimisation or discontinuation.
  • Work with product, game-design and development teams on version planning, feature optimisation, implementation and release readiness.
  • Partner with marketing and user-acquisition teams on launch and growth plans, using acquisition cost, conversion, LTV and ROI data to optimise investment and product strategy.
  • Monitor market trends, channel performance and competitor activity, and apply relevant insights to product positioning and long-term operational planning.
  • Lead and coach operations staff, document product-analysis and decision-making methodologies, and promote consistent data-driven operating practices across the team. 

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in game product operations, live operations or a related role, including at least 3 years in a lead, supervisory or project-owner capacity.
  • Proven experience using player and commercial data to improve retention, payer conversion, ARPPU, LTV, revenue or other key live-product metrics.
  • Strong understanding of game monetisation and commercialisation models, including in-app purchases, season passes, player-segment-based offers, promotional packages and rewarded advertising.
  • Experience in structured product evaluation, version optimisation, market research, competitor analysis and cross-functional project delivery.
  • Strong analytical skills and practical experience using game analytics dashboards, user-acquisition data and operational performance metrics.
  • Experience with casual, social, mobile or web games, including SLG, MMORPG or card-game products, would be an advantage.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, leadership and communication skills, with good written and spoken Mandarin and the ability to read English reports and documents; Cantonese would be an advantage. 

Application Process
To apply, please click "Apply Now" and submit your application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team regarding the next steps of the selection process
